properties.name: 神倉山麓 study area · Kamikura mountain foot
west edge
properties.rule: 25 m (horizontal) upslope of the slope break on GSI DEM1A (1 m)

properties.name: north edge
properties.rule: lane closing the first full block north of the school and the temple row (OSM 266991552, 121369902)

properties.name: east edge
properties.rule: street bounding the 千穂小学校 compound on the east, continued south (OSM 121367848, 1031510641, 121367953)

properties.name: south edge
properties.rule: street just south of the shrine-entrance cluster, carried west across the foot of the steps (OSM 121367975, 121370515, 499568826)

properties.name: slope break
properties.rule: edge of ground ≥1 m above the plain and steeper than 12° (or ≥3 m above it), connected to the slopes above 40 m; GSI DEM1A

properties.name: mountain foot (consensus)
properties.rule: per-profile median of four definitions (mask edge, plain + 1 m, greatest concavity, two-segment hinge) on cross-profiles every 2 m; GSI DEM1A

properties.name: transect
properties.via: the path and the stone steps (OSM 121369321, 121366071) to the bridge over 市田川
